tasks.label: Flash Pico - Phase 6 20 MHz scope diagnostic
tasks.detail: Build and force flash the isolated no-I/O CPU/SRAM scope diagnostic without waiting for a firmware stop handshake; CP/M disks and ENV are preserved.
tasks.command: if [ "${input:picoPhase6FlashSafety}" != "Proceed" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Flash cancelled; Pico was not touched.'; exit 1; fi; . .venv-flash/bin/activate && python -c 'import sys, serial; print("Using", sys.executable)' && cmake -S . -B build/scope20 -G Ninja -DPICO_BOARD=pico2_w && cmake --build build/scope20 --target z80_stage06_scope_20mhz -j && python scripts/pico_flash.py firmware build/scope20/src/stage06_sram_dma/z80_stage06_scope_20mhz.uf2 --power-confirmed --force

tasks.label: Flash Pico - Phase 10 WebSocket terminal
tasks.detail: Build and force flash firmware without waiting for a stop handshake; preserves CP/M disks and ENV.
tasks.command: if [ "${input:picoFlashSafety}" != "Proceed" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Flash cancelled; Pico was not touched.'; exit 1; fi; . .venv-flash/bin/activate && python -c 'import sys, serial; print("Using", sys.executable)' && cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DPICO_BOARD=pico2_w && cmake --build build --target z80_stage10_websocket_terminal -j && python scripts/pico_flash.py firmware build/src/stage10_websocket_terminal/z80_stage10_websocket_terminal.uf2 --power-confirmed --force

tasks.label: Flash Pico - All disks (A-D)
tasks.detail: Replace all disks from src/disks/source-altair; regenerate native A and convert B-D at flash time. No backups; firmware, boot and ENV are preserved.
tasks.command: if [ "${input:picoDiskFlashSafety}" != "Replace selected disks" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Disk flash cancelled; Pico was not touched.'; exit 1; fi; . .venv-flash/bin/activate && python -c 'import sys, serial; print("Using", sys.executable)' && python src/disks/convert_altair_disks.py --output-dir build/cpm-disk-update/converted && python src/cpm/build_images.py --disk-dir build/cpm-disk-update/converted --output-dir build/cpm-disk-update && python scripts/pico_flash.py disks --drive A=build/cpm-disk-update/drive_a_cpm63k-z80.img --drive B=src/disks/source-altair/bdsc-v1.60.dsk --drive C=src/disks/source-altair/escape-posix.dsk --drive D=src/disks/source-altair/blank.dsk --power-confirmed

tasks.label: Flash Pico - Drive A
tasks.detail: Regenerate native A from src/disks/source-altair/cpm63k.dsk; installed boot compatibility is checked. No backups.
tasks.command: if [ "${input:picoDiskFlashSafety}" != "Replace selected disks" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Disk flash cancelled; Pico was not touched.'; exit 1; fi; . .venv-flash/bin/activate && python -c 'import sys, serial; print("Using", sys.executable)' && python src/disks/convert_altair_disks.py --output-dir build/cpm-disk-update/converted && python src/cpm/build_images.py --disk-dir build/cpm-disk-update/converted --output-dir build/cpm-disk-update && python scripts/pico_flash.py disks --drive A=build/cpm-disk-update/drive_a_cpm63k-z80.img --power-confirmed

tasks.label: Flash Pico - Drive B
tasks.detail: Replace only B from src/disks/source-altair/bdsc-v1.60.dsk (BDS C), converted and verified at flash time; no backups.
tasks.command: if [ "${input:picoDiskFlashSafety}" != "Replace selected disks" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Disk flash cancelled; Pico was not touched.'; exit 1; fi; . .venv-flash/bin/activate && python -c 'import sys, serial; print("Using", sys.executable)' && python scripts/pico_flash.py disks --drive B=src/disks/source-altair/bdsc-v1.60.dsk --power-confirmed

tasks.label: Flash Pico - Drive C
tasks.detail: Replace only C from src/disks/source-altair/escape-posix.dsk, converted and verified at flash time; no backups.
tasks.command: if [ "${input:picoDiskFlashSafety}" != "Replace selected disks" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Disk flash cancelled; Pico was not touched.'; exit 1; fi; . .venv-flash/bin/activate && python -c 'import sys, serial; print("Using", sys.executable)' && python scripts/pico_flash.py disks --drive C=src/disks/source-altair/escape-posix.dsk --power-confirmed

tasks.label: Flash Pico - Drive D
tasks.detail: Replace only D from src/disks/source-altair/blank.dsk, converted and verified at flash time; no backups.
tasks.command: if [ "${input:picoDiskFlashSafety}" != "Replace selected disks" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Disk flash cancelled; Pico was not touched.'; exit 1; fi; . .venv-flash/bin/activate && python -c 'import sys, serial; print("Using", sys.executable)' && python scripts/pico_flash.py disks --drive D=src/disks/source-altair/blank.dsk --power-confirmed

tasks.label: Prepare interactive CP/M emulator
tasks.command: cmake -S src/cpm/z80_debug_host -B build/cpm/z80_debug_host -DZ80_DEBUG_HOST_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF && cmake --build build/cpm/z80_debug_host && cmake -S src/cpm/dcc_io_adapter -B build/cpm/dcc_io_adapter -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF && cmake --build build/cpm/dcc_io_adapter && python3 src/cpm/build_images.py --assembler z80asm --output-dir build/cpm

Selected disks will be overwritten with no backups. Confirm external +5 V is applied before USB and CP/M work is saved.
